# Phase Two — Improved Brainstorm

The Awtsmoos gives every layer its proper border, neither swallowing nor fleeing;
Awtsmoos.com should let the user see one current purpose, not five panels competing to be seen.

## Improved model

Treat mobile Heichel as four vertical strata:

1. compact Heichel identity;
2. Living Path orientation and current-view controls;
3. current-view content only;
4. optional contextual utilities after content.

Global navigation is a fixed fifth stratum outside the document flow and receives explicit clearance. Advanced Platform becomes an inline optional utility on mobile, after the content context, so it cannot cover strata 1–3.

## State rule

`appState.currentContent` is canonical loaded content. Every synthetic record must be inserted there before `LivingPathFilterController.renderCommitted()`. The active view determines not only which viewport is visible, but also which contextual discovery modules may appear.

## Cache rule

Any source fix that users must receive immediately needs a module-entry cache version change. Version only at a stable entrypoint so internal module URLs inherit a fresh import graph through the new top-level request when browser/module caching permits; if imports are absolute unversioned, introduce explicit version query where necessary rather than trusting stale cache invalidation.
